title: The brick wall
summary: Two loops, one inside the other, build a wall of 28 bricks.
done: You saw two nested loops and clones.

hello.text: In level 2, a brick wall! Click **New** above the blocks to see what changed.

wall.text: A **loop** repeats blocks. Here there are two: for each row (1 to 4), we make 7 columns.

place.text: The position comes from the counters: x = col × 45, y = 60 + row × 40. Then we create a clone there.

break.text: A brick hit by the ball is deleted, and the ball goes the other way.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Look: [create a clone of Brick] lights up 28 times, one brick at a time.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Stop slow motion to play at normal speed.

rows.hint: It is the outer loop: “from 1 to 4”.

spin.text: Make the ball turn when it breaks a brick.
spin.hint: Put [turn Ball by … degrees] in “when Brick touches Ball”.
